verdict.rationale: mParticle documents routing data to 'hundreds of vendors' through an integrations directory covering marketing, analytics, and warehouse partners. Community users describe sending events once to mParticle and forwarding them to about 10 analytics providers. Per-destination control is shown through forwarding rules (e.g. 'Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present'), consent filters, and transforms applied as data leaves mParticle, though mapping and filtering appear mostly as page titles. Missing for 10: detailed docs on per-destination field/event mapping, general (non-consent) per-output event filtering, and independent hands-on corroboration of catalog depth.
